name: t27
why: t25 (t22's recipe on the corrected cache r9) with one change: the transferred part of the 8,247 genes whose shared response fewer than two universes can estimate (t23's share = 0, reports/trasferimento/quota_condivisa_2026-09-27/t23/share.csv) is set to 0; every other gene keeps its full value (share 1), with no per-gene weighting and no rescale. This is the arm the pre-registered ablation of t23 preferred on the proxy (excl_noscale: exclusion helps, weighting beyond it does not, rescaling to t22's detectable genes hurts; reports/trasferimento/ablazione_t23_2026-09-27/). Officially t23 raised pds_cosine by +0.0109 raw while its DE members fell (CP-0042), and t26 showed that the weakly expressed genes are not where that gain came from (CP-0045); in A/B/C this exclusion touches 947-1,197 expressed genes (>= 5 CPM) and about 7,200 weakly expressed ones. The list is per gene, estimated from universes outside the panel, so it applies unchanged to D/E/F. Sources, weights, amplitude, shrinkage, gamma, cache and cis head as t25.
